name: Pangaea supercontinent
summary: The supercontinent Pangaea assembled in the late Paleozoic and began breaking apart in the Jurassic, shaping the continents we know today.

name: Chicxulub impact
summary: An asteroid struck the Yucatán peninsula, triggering the mass extinction that ended the age of dinosaurs.

name: Dawn of agriculture
summary: Farming emerged in the Fertile Crescent, enabling permanent settlements and the rise of civilization.

name: Unification of Egypt
summary: Upper and Lower Egypt were unified under the first pharaoh, beginning three millennia of Egyptian civilization.

name: Founding of Rome
summary: Traditional date of Rome's founding, seed of the republic and empire that would shape the Mediterranean world.

name: Punic Wars
summary: Three wars between Rome and Carthage for dominance of the western Mediterranean.

name: Battle of Cannae
summary: Hannibal's double envelopment annihilated a larger Roman army — still studied in military academies.

name: Gutenberg printing press
summary: Movable-type printing made books cheap, accelerating the spread of knowledge across Europe.

name: Columbus reaches the Americas
summary: First sustained contact between the Old World and the New, opening the Columbian Exchange.

name: World War II
summary: The deadliest conflict in history, fought across every ocean and most continents.
body:
The Second World War drew in more than **100 million** people from over 30 countries.

Its turning points included the [Battle of Stalingrad](event:stalingrad) on the Eastern Front, and it ended in the Pacific shortly after the [Trinity test](event:trinity) opened the nuclear age.

More at [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_War_II).

image.caption: US troops landing at Omaha Beach, 1944

name: Battle of Stalingrad
summary: The turning point of the Eastern Front; the Wehrmacht's Sixth Army was destroyed in the ruined city.
body: Part of [World War II](event:ww2). Roughly **two million** casualties made it one of the bloodiest battles in history; the Soviet counter-offensive *Operation Uranus* encircled the Sixth Army.

name: Trinity nuclear test
summary: The first detonation of a nuclear weapon, in the New Mexico desert.

name: Apollo 11 Moon landing
summary: Humans walked on another world for the first time, launched from Cape Kennedy.
body:
*That's one small step for man...* Apollo 11 fulfilled the goal set eight years earlier of landing a man on the Moon and returning him safely to the Earth.

Details: [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Apollo_11).

image.caption: Buzz Aldrin on the lunar surface

name: World Wide Web
summary: Tim Berners-Lee proposed the Web at CERN, transforming how humanity shares information.

name: Black Death
summary: The deadliest pandemic in recorded history swept across Europe, killing an estimated third to half of its population.
body:
Arriving via Genoese trading ships in 1347, the plague spread along trade routes across the continent within five years.

Its aftermath reshaped **labor, religion and art** across Europe for generations.

More at [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Black_Death).
